# nodejs

Node.js's license (`LICENSE`, the MIT notices at the top of Node v22.22.2's `LICENSE`), for the
code in `node/` ported from Node.js: the `node/prelude` modules that name the Node.js file they
come from, and `node/src/host_zlib.c` (from Node's `src/node_zlib.cc`). Nothing here is compiled.
